"""Audit event message wire formatter."""
import copy
from key_normalizer import normalize_dict_keys, extract_normalized_keys, to_snake_case
from wire_envelope import build_envelope, is_valid_envelope, extract_payload
from typing import Dict, Any, List

def _deep_normalize(data: Any) -> Any:
    """Recursively normalize dict keys to snake_case and deep copy."""
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        return {to_snake_case(k): _deep_normalize(v) for k, v in data.items()}
    elif isinstance(data, list):
        return [_deep_normalize(item) for item in data]
    else:
        return copy.deepcopy(data)

def format_audit_event(data: Dict[str, Any], epoch_ms: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Format audit event message.
